clips.title: The story
paras: Wiley's Note is a confidential missive penned by the Lakeshire rogue Wiley the Black, paid as a debt to Gryan Stoutmantle. Its contents reveal alarming alliances formed by the Defias Brotherhood and draw Stormwind's intelligence service into the investigation.

Penned in Redridge by the shady rogue Wiley the Black, this scribbled dispatch is handed over to settle an old favor owed to Gryan Stoutmantle. Within, Wiley exposes what he knows about the Defias Brotherhood's clandestine ambitions. His intelligence reveals that the brotherhood is not operating alone: they have brokered alliances with regional gnolls, kobolds, and goblin operatives to further their operations across the kingdom.
